values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267. Check-in 3 p.m. (arriving earlier means paying the day-use fee); after 4 p.m. the check-in packet is at the far-right gate. Day-use reservations are required on weekends and holidays Memorial Day through Labor Day weekend.

If you arrive before check-in, you must pay the day-use fee. If you arrive after 4pm, your check-in packet will be at the far-right gate.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/pointlookout.aspx, read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR says 'There are 90 wooded campsites; 26 of these have full hook-ups and an additional 4 of these have electric only'; the booking site currently lists 71: Tulip Loop 20 full-hookup sites to 40 ft (self-contained campers only, no restrooms), Hoffman's Loop 21 non-electric + 4 electric and Malone Loop 26 non-electric, mostly 30 ft (a few 20). Leashed pets only in Tulip, Conoy and Hoffman's loops.

values.note: Park store (snacks, ice, bait, camping supplies) open Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day. Tulip Loop has no restrooms.

summary: Confirmed on DNR's park page and the MD booking site: reservable 365 days ahead and same-day online; 30-amp max with water/sewer at the 20 Tulip full-hookup sites, 4 electric-only; 71 sites on the booking site (DNR says 90), to 40 ft; showers, dump station, seasonal park store. Fees left (manual 2026-10-12). Not stated for this park: weekend/holiday minimums (left inherited), fcfs. AWH's restoration note is consistent with the booking site (no Conoy Loop sites listed) and kept.
flags: Season (manual, not overwritten): the entry says 'Opens April 1; no closing date posted', but the booking site posts reservable dates 'Hoffman's Loop & Malone Loop: April 1, 2026-October 31, 2026; Tulip Loop: April 1, 2026-November 29, 2026' (2027: Oct 31 / Nov 27) (https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/point-lookout-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380123, Season Dates). Consider closes 10-31 with a note that the full-hookup Tulip Loop runs to the Sunday after Thanksgiving.
Phone: entry has none; DNR and the booking site give 301-872-5688 (Information) for Point Lookout.

Waterfront re-audit lead: DNR lists 90 sites but the booking site lists only Tulip, Hoffman's and Malone loops (71 sites); AWH's note says the waterfront RV loop is under restoration. If the bayfront value rests on the loop that is closed (apparently Conoy), check whether any open loop is on the bay.
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's park page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/pointlookout.aspx.
